ambiguities.detail: The '@tanstack/custom-condition' -> ./src/index.ts export condition is the documented dev-mode convention (root tsconfig customConditions; vitest resolve.conditions). M0 supports only import/require/default conditions, so the analyzer reaches src/index.ts via the absent-dist src fallback at I, not via the condition at R. Do not expect R here in v0.1-alpha.
exports map -> build/modern, legacy main/module/types -> build/legacy. Same src feeds both; source analysis is unaffected. A dist-analyzing tool would see two trees.

@tanstack/react-query's public API = export * from '@tanstack/query-core' (whole core) + hooks. Computing it requires the workspace:* hop into query-core — a tool that stops at the package boundary under-reports the surface.

excludedFacts.detail: Repo-wide file counts beyond query-core/src; per-adapter barrel depths beyond react-query.
Whether modern and legacy builds are byte-identical in module graph — build configs compared, not byte-compared.

workspace:* dep; M0 lacks custom-condition support so src/index.ts is reached via absent-dist (build/modern) src fallback at I. True dev-mode mapping via @tanstack/custom-condition is R by tsconfig convention.
